brief:
President Mahmoud Abbas departed Cairo following a two-day visit and meeting with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, Shehab Wire reported. Discussions centered on Gaza, the Palestinian cause, and coordination with Egypt, though the visit yielded no announced breakthrough in Fatah reconciliation efforts.

The timing of the presidential visit coincided with broader discussions around November elections and competing Palestinian political lists, suggesting wider efforts to address internal Palestinian political divisions alongside regional diplomatic engagement.
dek: President Mahmoud Abbas departed Cairo following a two-day visit and meeting with Egyptian President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi, Shehab Wire reported.
title: Abbas leaves Cairo after talks with Sisi on Gaza, Palestine
